headline: 5 program/role addresses catalogued on Solana (1 core program, 1 staging program, 1 governance multisig role, 2 GitHub repos); no EVM addresses; Solana explorer and DeFiPunkd on-chain API unsupported for this chain.

findings.text: D1: Solana is not supported by the EVM block explorers enumerated in the checklist (etherscan.io, basescan.org, etc.) nor by the DeFiPunkd read API (supported chainIds do not include Solana). Core program ID MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA discovered from docs.0.xyz/protocol-overview/program-addresses. Staging program stag8sTKds2h4KzjUw3zKTsxbqvT4XKHdaR9X9E6Rct also listed. No EVM-format addresses found.
D2: Canonical deployed-contracts page found at https://docs.0.xyz/protocol-overview/program-addresses listing mrgnLend v2 mainnet program and staging program. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: Audits page linked at https://docs.0.xyz/protocol-overview/audits per docs nav; out of fetch budget to retrieve. Blog post (Sep 2025) states Kamino integration is 'audited (multiple times)' and Drift/Save integrations were 'in audit' at launch. No specific audit firm names or PDF URLs confirmed from fetched sources.

D4: GitHub repos identified from docs.0.xyz/protocol-overview/program-addresses: protocol repo at github.com/mrgnlabs/marginfi-v2 (also mirrored at github.com/0dotxyz/marginfi-v2 per GitHub org search result) and TypeScript SDK at github.com/0dotxyz/p0-ts-sdk. No broadcast deployment artifacts fetched this run due to fetch budget exhaustion.
D5: Protocol is Solana-only; all sources confirm single-chain deployment. No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: Bank factory pattern documented — each asset has a Bank account under the Group. No enumeration API callable via DeFiPunkd (Solana not supported). Individual bank addresses not surfaced this run; factory cap notice recorded in unknowns.

D7: Role taxonomy: mrgnLend v2 program = 'other' (core protocol program); Group admin role documented as 'typically a secure governance multisig' per architecture docs but specific multisig address not surfaced this run. Staging program = 'other'.

D8: Both program addresses trace to fetched URL https://docs.0.xyz/protocol-overview/program-addresses. Group admin multisig address not found in any fetched source — recorded in unknowns, not in admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Walked protocol website, docs, blog, DeFiLlama, GitHub org search, and Solana.com verified builds page. Catalogued 2 on-chain Solana program addresses (core + staging) and identified 2 GitHub repos and 1 docs deployments page. On-chain state reads are blocked because Solana is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API or any EVM block explorer; the group admin multisig address was not surfaced from any fetched document, leaving admin address discovery incomplete.

evidence.shows: Protocol website confirms Project 0 is a DeFi-native prime broker on Solana; Sentry release SHA d5f67a3d46ebacd7b7e93e565f0ae19f6869f55b visible in meta baggage tag.

Confirms protocol is Solana-only ($47.07m TVL), category Lending, website app.0.xyz; links to DeFiLlama adapter at github.com/DefiLlama/DefiLlama-Adapters/blob/main/projects/p0/index.js for TVL methodology.

Launch blog (Sep 2025): Project 0 powers marginfi program and dApp; built on mrgnLendv2; Kamino integration 'audited (multiple times)'; Drift/Save 'in audit'; token planned for 2025 Solana Breakpoint; governance discussions to begin Oct 15 2025; GitHub repo referenced as github.com/mrgnlabs/marginfi-v2.
Official documentation site; states P0 is built on mrgnLendv2; links to architecture, audits, and program-addresses pages; confirms Solana mainnet deployment.

Describes Group/Bank/Account/Balance data model; states 'Each Group has a single administrator (typically a secure governance multisig)'; all assets on app.0.xyz belong to a single Group overseen by the foundation; developer guides on GitHub at github.com/mrgnlabs/marginfi-v2/tree/main/guides.

Canonical deployed-contracts page: mrgnLend v2 mainnet program = MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA; staging program = stag8sTKds2h4KzjUw3zKTsxbqvT4XKHdaR9X9E6Rct; protocol GitHub = github.com/mrgnlabs/marginfi-v2; SDK GitHub = github.com/0dotxyz/p0-ts-sdk.

GitHub org for Project 0 (0dotxyz): repos include 0dotxyz/marginfi-v2 (Rust, Apache-2.0, fork of mrgnlabs/marginfi-v2), 0dotxyz/p0-ts-sdk, 0dotxyz/mrgn-ts-scripts, 0dotxyz/p0-animations, 0dotxyz/p0-agents, 0dotxyz/pyth-crosschain, 0dotxyz/solana-dex-superagg.

Confirms founder MacBrennan Peet; protocol launched Sep 2025 as first multi-venue DeFi-native prime broker on Solana; backed by investors (Multicoin Capital, Pantera Capital, Solana Ventures per other sources); permissionless on-chain protocol.

unknowns: D1: Solana block explorer (explorer.solana.com, solscan.io) not in fetch allowlist and DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chainId — on-chain program account state (upgrade authority, owner) could not be verified this run
D3: Audits page https://docs.0.xyz/protocol-overview/audits not fetched due to budget exhaustion — specific audit firm names, PDF URLs, and dates remain unknown

D6: Individual Bank account addresses not enumerated — DeFiPunkd API unsupported for Solana; bank factory enumeration not possible via supported tools; potentially 101+ bank accounts (DeFiLlama shows 101 pools tracked)
D7: Group admin multisig address not surfaced from any fetched document — docs say 'typically a secure governance multisig' but specific pubkey unknown; record as unknowns pending next run
D8: Group admin multisig Solana pubkey — sighted only as role description in architecture docs, no address value found; cannot add to admin_addresses without the address

protocol_metadata.about: Project 0 is a DeFi-native prime broker and unified margin protocol built on Solana, built on top of the mrgnLendv2 program (originally the marginfi-v2 codebase). Users deposit assets and borrow against their entire cross-venue DeFi portfolio — spanning Kamino, Drift, Jupiter Lend, and other integrated protocols — through a single margin account, with risk assessed holistically across all positions. The protocol aggregates collateral from multiple lending venues without requiring users to move assets, eliminating isolated liquidation risk from single-venue overcollateralization. Project 0 aims to evolve into a full prime broker supporting perp positions and other DeFi instrument types under unified margin.
